assertions are evaluated by the agent driving the page
deleting rows a session wrote is a deliberate CLI step with a dry run

gaps.dashboard: it is a separate page (docs/surfacemap.html), generated from the code

meta.mcpExempt: process control - launches a real OS browser process on the caller's own machine, same category as relay start/stop
process control - spawns a local static-file-server process on the caller's own machine, same category as relay start/stop
process control - kills a local process by pid, same category as relay start/stop
greps the CLI process's own working directory for a leftover debug tag - the MCP server has no stable cwd contract
walks and rewrites files under the CLI's working directory - the MCP server has no stable cwd contract
an open-ended stream has no request/response shape - an MCP caller polls "friction notices" with the since cursor instead
compares the vendored harness of another project with this checkout - a maintainer task, not an agent capability
copies harness files into another project on the local machine - a maintainer task, not an agent capability
an indefinite streaming poll with no single request/response mapping - MCP callers use "idb wait" for a bounded check
process control of the relay itself - not something an MCP tool call should be able to do to its own backend

process control of the relay itself - not something an MCP tool call should be able to do to its own backend
deletes temp dirs and kills browser processes on the local machine - host housekeeping, not something an MCP tool call should trigger
host disk housekeeping report - not an MCP capability
reads the calling agent's own transcript file off disk after the fact - an agent already knows why it acted, and an MCP tool that took a transcript path would only be a way to make it read one

the dashboard's own derived views (swimlane/state machine/episodes/sequence/waste/cost/failure-heatmap/causality/route-FSM) - an agent already gets the same evidence from session show/report; this is a human debugging convenience for comparing against what the dashboard renders, not a distinct capability
regenerates docs/surfacemap.html in this checkout - a maintainer task, not something an agent calls
CI-style staleness check of docs/surfacemap.html in this checkout - not an agent capability
starts a local web server that runs until Ctrl+C - a person looks at it, an agent has no use for it
